messages.author: c052ac5727650828
messages.subject: ADVI in pyStan
parts:
Dear Stan Users,

I was wondering how to access to ADVI in pystan. I have installed pystan from git repo and I can see that here:

pystan/pystan/stan_fit.hpp

but it seems that interface is not implemented (or I am missing something). I searched online and till Feb, there was no interface apparently:

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/35340732/variational-inference-in-pystan-api

I was wondering if this has already change and if so how to access ADVI in python,

Thanks,
Kayhan

​

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] ADVI in pyStan
parts:
It's still considered "experimental" in rstan, so it's not advertised in the doc to the extent that MCMC and optimization are, but like Dustin said check out the help page for the vb function. In short, instead of calling stan() you need to use stan_model() to compile the model and then call vb().

Jonah
